configurations.name: brutex — the whole application (press Run on THIS one). Stamps the build with HEAD, because crates/cli/src/lib.rs commit_stamp() reads BRUTEX_COMMIT at COMPILE time and a server built without it refuses every sweep by CLAUDE.md §3 rule 3.
runtimeArgs: BRUTEX_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) exec cargo run --release -p api -- serve
